steps.name: Ultimate Dessert (1)
steps.objective: After talking with [Io] in “Gerda,” go to [Zelic] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What is this? How did you find this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As Io said, after hearing the story from Madeline, I went to the Fountain of Echoes and found something like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I gave one to Madeline, and I got another one and brought it to Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's been a long time since I saw the real thing... . When I saw it as a child... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a gift. Madeleine said she wanted to give it to me. I also wanted to give it to you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hehe, thank you.
(As Io smiles softly, the ice in Io's hand melts.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Deborah is a snowflake, and more accurately, it is called an eternal snowflake. A flower trapped in ice, eternal hope and infinite comfort... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It must have been near where Echo was.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … I gave it to Echo, who was anxious.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Let us protect this hope and comfort.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I definitely do that. we! But didn’t you say you were going to get some rest?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's right. I tried to just relax for a few days without thinking about anything, but I don't think that's going to work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: There's nothing wrong... . I want to eat something delicious.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Of course, it's not that Galette's food isn't delicious, it's just that I want to eat something else... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Sometimes there are guys who leave something like a cake and run away, but that's rare these days... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You know that too, right? Those kids in black clothes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Every time I go, they give me lots of food.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'd like to teach Gallet how to make the food there, can I ask you a favor?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. It's Io's request.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hehe, thank you. Then, if you find out anything, go straight to Gallet. You don't have to come to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Hey, see you later.

steps.name: Ultimate Dessert (2)
steps.objective: Obtain <Mint Chocolate Cream Bread> at the “Magic Academy Main Building”. Then talk to [Galet] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hello Adventurer. Sweet potato mousse cake, tiramisu, or cheesecake, which would you like? There is also carrot cake.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. If you already give it to me like this... .

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Uhuhu, since I haven't been able to give it to Adventurer, I'm going to fill it in for you!

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: If it's not enough, please tell me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t think it will be enough!

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I feel sorry for you when you say that... . By the way, what brought you here? You probably didn't come here to eat cake and dessert because you wanted to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Zelic that Io wants a new dessert.)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Oh, you are a great person too. You want a new dessert... . I left a bunch of cake boxes like Santa Claus at the entrance to the village, and it worked.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: The special snow and ice in the snowfield kept it fresh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … How far are you going to get dessert?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Except for places you can't normally go to, like the Demon World, I guess they sprayed it almost everywhere?
(Zelik shows a proud expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's amazing.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I recently made bread that suits the tastes of Zerenis students at Magic Academy, and it looks like it will be good!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Zelic.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Instead of giving you a recipe, I have one condition.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Conditions?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: You have to taste it. It is an exclusive supply at the Magic Academy Zerenis school store, so I think you will have to go there and get it in person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aha. I'll go and get some.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Gerda: If people want to eat it, there should be at least fifty, right? There will be a lot of bread hidden by students, so please get fifty and take them with you! These are my conditions!

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hehehe! Well then, I'm busy so I'll just go in.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I became a food delivery person... . Anyway, what kind of bread is it?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: I came here because it smelled delicious, and %s came with a lot of things. I see that Io is already looking forward to it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I don't know if you'll like it because students like it.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Io says he likes to eat anything, but this is what %s brought... .
(Galet takes out a mint chocolate cream bread and puts it in his mouth.)

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: This unique, soft mint cream and strong, sweet chocolate cream mixed together is definitely... .

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: After all, it’s bread from another continent.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: It's definitely not my taste, but I think it will be a refreshing stimulus for Gerda people.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: If I get the chance, I would like to invite the person who put cake in a box and scattered it at the entrance to the village.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: How can you make food like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There will be an opportunity later. Uh, but that… .

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Oh, this is the frame that Madeline asked me to hang inside the store. It’s a snowflake, but it’s really pretty, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That flower... . I see Then I'll look around somewhere else. See you later.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: %s, come eat later. Phew, since there are no guests, I guess I’ll just go for a walk… .

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: As expected, if you say something like this, customers will come.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Welcome! My name is Gallet, and I run the inn Snow Flower, Flowers on Sparkling Snow. Is this your first time in town?
(A woman approaches Gallet. She looks like a monk, but the sight of her holding a sword gives her a strange feeling.)

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Guest? Why are you so blank?

lines.speaker: 여성 수도사
lines.text: Oh, no. Because I have a weakness for handsome men... . Huh. no. Io said I could tell Mr. Gallet about the accommodation… .

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Haha, I see. What is your name? I have to write an accommodation report.

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: Me, me! It's called Le, Ren!
